recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If the original V2 version-specific value-set policy needs reassessment, handle it through a THO/UTG proposal; do not restore the old core V2 value-set tab or edit inactive V2 templates as a core reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 request to provide version-dependent and version-independent HL7 V2 value set URLs and identifiers and document what V2 version or set of versions each value set covered.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-9961 was found. The 2016 Zulip discussion records the intended approach: generate version-specific V2 value sets while using the same value set URL with different versions. The historical core value-set page surface was later superseded by UTG migration, especially commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 removing the HL7 v2 value-set tab and v2VSIndex placeholder from source/terminologies-valuesets.html.
additional_context: The Jira's 2018 comment says the issue was now a UTG thing. VOC/Vocab minutes in 2019 and 2021 record that FHIR vocabulary details would move to UTG/THO and that Version 2.x vocabulary was replaced in THO. Current core source points users to HL7 Terminology for additional value sets and has no active V2 value-set entries. The related FHIR-26836 audit is already on the combined branch, and FHIR-25896 clarified the same Value Sets page to exclude non-core HL7 Terminology value sets.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No HL7/fhir source was changed because any remaining version-dependent/independent V2 value-set identifier work belongs in THO/UTG rather than the current core FHIR checkout.

related_jiras.note: Already represented on the combined branch; it audited the removed HL7 v2 Value Sets tab and concluded remaining URI behavior belongs to HL7 Terminology/THO rather than the core page.
Later Published source change clarified that value sets defined in HL7 Terminology outside the core specification are not listed on source/terminologies-valuesets.html.
